name: Sir Willoughby Jones
bioAdditions: Second son of Maj.-Gen. Sir John Thomas Jones, 1st Bt, and Catherine (Catharine Maria) Lawrence, daughter of Capt. Effingham Lawrence (S1, S2): 5th cousin 6 times removed. Eton and Trinity, Cambridge; inherited the baronetcy when his brother Lawrence was murdered in Turkey (1845); MP for Cheltenham from July 1847 (S2). No free image found.

sources.citation: Thomas Lawrence, Historical Genealogy of the Lawrence Family (1858) (archive.org full text), p. 49
sources.supports: Catharine Maria Lawrence m. Sir John Thomas Jones; children Lawrence, Willoughby, Herbert Walsingham, Emily Florence
